finding: The only notice-index candidate, bfc-2021-146:p36, was read from its page image (page 37) and rejected: it prints A139 under Chambolle-Musigny, not Aloxe-Corton. The curation records the rejected reference with its reason. The raw OCR sweep's other hits naming a bundle commune, bfc-2020-072:p58 (Michel Gayot et Fils, dossier 2019-173, page 59: Pernand-Vergelesses A1 to I1) and bfc-2022-059:p48 (EARL de Chenove, dossier 2021-179, page 49: Pernand-Vergelesses C and AC references, Savigny-les-Beaune D references), were read from their page images; none of their references is reachable from this cru. All other raw hits never name a bundle commune and are recorded but not assigned. No exact notice event is supported for this cru.
